reuse.why: The change reuses getBulkBudgetCategories, averageToBudget, extractTagsFromText, spreadsheet helpers, and the existing mutation and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: Category eligibility and amount-sign decisions remain shared, with no substantive duplicated decision logic.

placement.why: Eligibility and budget calculations stay in budget/actions.ts, while typed method registration stays in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The changes address the requested budget actions and tests, apart from an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: A shared options type and centralized eligibility rules keep all month-wide consumers consistent while preserving explicit missing-group variation.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions use getBulkBudgetCategories, and the new action uses averageToBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: The new action shares selection and sign conversion rather than reshaping copies of those decisions.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories renames its existing hidden-category option and adds shared exclusion rules without introducing caller-specific exceptions or bypasses.
